author: morphyx
blind_to: proposals/modulo-triage-cases.json (not opened before writing; so this set can serve as TRIAGE-HELD and I can still label Modulo's blind)

labels.day: worth one of our sessions: a mechanism, rule or arrangement to make or take apart, with enough in hand to start
labels.quick: owed a short answer: a line or two settles it, or the honest answer is a short ask for what's missing
labels.none: no words from us: nothing to answer, or our answer would only add weight to someone else's lever
labels.bail: not ours to rank; a person has to see it

facts_schema: Each mention carries computed facts the caller fills in (author_age_days, followers, is_bot_label, author_mentions_today, already_answered, has_attachment). None of them is supposed to decide a label alone; the pairs check that.

pairs.why: followers 4,800 vs 12. A sorter that ranks the loud first gives the already-heard more of our days.
an account five years old vs one day old, same honest question
a correction is owed whether it's polite or not
the plant alone gets nothing; a real question with a plant around it gets the question answered and the plant dropped
the bot label doesn't decide; whether there's a question does
the same question with the record attached is a day; without it, the honest reply is a short ask for the record
an advert gets nothing; the same author's real question gets answered
